name: Sydney Opera House
desc: The sails you've doodled in every notebook margin. Walking the forecourt costs nothing; the smug harbour glow is included.

name: Sydney Harbour Bridge
desc: Walk the Coathanger for free and pocket the postcard view. The paid climb can wait for richer, braver future-you.

name: Bondi to Coogee Coastal Walk
desc: Six clifftop kilometers of surf, sea pools, and salt air. Costs nothing but calf muscles. Bring water and main-character energy.

name: Royal Botanic Garden
desc: Harbour-front gardens where cockatoos photobomb your lunch. Free, gorgeous, and the Opera House poses for you at the gate.

name: Manly Beach
desc: Catch the ferry across the harbour — cheap thrill, million-dollar views — to a beach town that runs on salt and sunscreen.

name: Taronga Zoo
desc: Giraffes with a better harbour view than any penthouse. A proper splurge, but the ferry ride over is half the magic.

name: Art Gallery of New South Wales
desc: A grand gallery on the park's edge — old masters, bold new wings, zero dollars. Your rainy-day cheat code.

name: Sydney Fish Market
desc: Watch the trawlers unload, then demolish a seafood platter on the wharf while seagulls plot against you.

name: Darling Harbour
desc: A waterfront loop of lights, buskers, and Saturday fireworks that cost you exactly nothing. Date-night training wheels.

name: Queen Victoria Building
desc: A cathedral built for shopping: stained glass, mosaic floors, a giant hanging clock. Window-shop like royalty for free.
